title: Addendum - Nomination to National Traders' Welfare Board

info.Creator: Scanner System
info.Title: F.No. P-55015/2/2019-Internal Trade Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade(Internal Trade and e-Commerce Section)

text: F.No. P-55015/2/2019-Internal Trade Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (Internal Trade and e-Commerce Section) ***** Vanijya Bhawank _New Delhi Dated:0 Time 20237(t,' ADDENDUM In partial modification of this Department's order of even No. dated 19.06.2023, the following sub-paras are inserted after sub-para (v) of the said order regarding nomination of members to National Traders' Welfare Board: (vi) Joint Secretary, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (dealing with Internal Trade) shall be the Convener of the Board. Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade shall provide secretarial assistance to the National Traders' Welfare Board. (vii) The Board shall meet at least once in every quarter. Quorum of the meeting shall be one-third of the total Members of the Board. (viii) Travelling/Dearness Allowances to the Members of the Board other than Official Members shall be regulated as per Mbo Finance, Department of Expenditure's OM No. 19047/1/2016-E-IV dated 14th September, 2017. (B4 ram Nath) Deputy Director 1. Chairperson and Members, NTWB 2. Secretary, Department of Commerce 3.
